projectState.summary: Byte 12b-b is implemented on `codex/byte-12b-b` and ready for Claude review. It adds deterministic inspect-only `SongSketchProposal`/responses, renders Proposal and Responses in the Song Sketch inspector, exposes `window.song.getProposal()`, uses bass role lookup for harmonic source selection, and returns cloned nested sketch arrays from `window.song.getSketch()`. Validation is green: `npm audit`, `npm run build`, focused smoke, full `npm run smoke` 16/16, `git diff --check`, plus an in-app browser sanity check of the new rows. No playback, transport, slow-thinking, validators, Ollama, persistence, or scheduling logic should have changed.
